name: Artanrecords Studio
summary: The artist platform being developed by Artanrecords for release preparation, agreements and royalty reporting.

visualLayers.notice: Custom visual layers are not connected in Studio yet.

overview.title: Where your next release begins
overview.description: Start with your music. Explore release preparation, agreements and reporting, or read the artist guidance before your next step.
overview.statusText: Private workspaces are not connected yet. You can explore Studio and its guidance; account access, reporting, signing and payouts are not available.

features.title: Release preparation
features.description: Keep titles, credits and release notes together. Private draft storage becomes available when account services are connected.

features.title: Agreements
features.description: A dedicated place for agreements shared by the label. Signing remains unavailable until the secure signing service is connected.

features.title: Listening and reporting
features.description: Listening data and royalty statements have separate places, without treating streaming counts as earnings.
